label: Scoped epistemic underminers and surviving rivals against F6
summary: Tested eight global epistemic challenges. Reused the canonical nihilism, performed-denial, goal-relative force and doubt results. Tested stronger readings with an eligibility omission model, opposite-truth and skewed benchmark comparisons, one valid and one invalid sequent in the same profile, and weak-certificate and non-well-founded strong-demonstration interpretations. The cases, precise assumptions and surviving rivals are in docs/notes/epistemic-underminer-boundaries.md.
blocker: Apart from the explicit incompatibility with thin F6, these consequences need a calibrated bridge to actual reasons, actual warrant, or a warranted hinge. Strong prior demonstration alone admits an infinitist model, and denying preference-independent force leaves the goal-relative account available. No new source attribution or root premise closure.
